title: Lamb Leg with Mediterranean Crust
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb leg dish with a crispy Mediterranean crust, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Rinse the lamb leg and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together yeast, mediterranean blend, and 1 tsp olive oil.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb leg, making sure to coat evenly.
Place the lamb leg in a roasting pan and sprinkle with aerated bread crumbs.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce heat to 375F (190C) and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes per pound, or until the internal temperature reaches 145F (63C).
Let the lamb rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
